name: discrete-acquisition-e1
title: 离散获取论题重估与 CSTATE 机制因子消融（E-1）
description: Phase-1 scientific reassessment of the TCOM mainline (direction space, prior-art calibration) plus the E-1 discriminative experiment: factorial ablation of covariance (full Gamma vs scalar) x support swaps (allowed vs forbidden) with a continue-only control arm, on saved F0-failed states, to establish whether CSTATE's gain is a covariance-aware support-decision mechanism or an extra-round/support-search effect.
creator: guoyikun
